# Amber Cathode

Amber Cathode is a dark theme built on an amber phosphor palette with monospaced typography throughout, aimed at the look of a CRT terminal. It layers on scanlines, phosphor glow and grain, a heavy vignette, sharp corners and a subtle flicker. Its recorded description also mentions a demo styled after a bulletin board system, carrying ASCII art and BASIC code.

![Amber Cathode screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bkindler/amber-cathode/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Amber Cathode"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply an amber CRT–inspired dark theme with an authentic phosphor palette and full monospace typography for a retro terminal feel. Add CRT scanlines, phosphor glow and grain, heavy vignette, sharp corners and subtle flicker; view a BBS-themed demo with ASCII art and BASIC code."
}
```
